title: How to survive a zombie apocalypse
idea: Survive it (realistic): five friends in a fifth-floor flat over a street full of zombies that hunt by sound; hunger sends them over a ladder to the shop roof, and one greedy sack of tins nearly kills them
format: series: Survive it (title spoken at 0.0, day HUD, one cause-and-effect chain, realistic, stands alone)

hook.what: opener A: the flat door is being forced at frame 0, a zombie arm holds the Samurai by the sash, Spud shoves a sofa at the door

captions.text: How to survive a zombie apocalypse

do.line: How to survive a zombie apocalypse.

do.reason: fists and bodies against the flat door
the zombies at the door
a police car's siren starts down in the street
the sofa hits the door wall, the door slams shut
the police siren, far up the street
hundreds of zombies shuffling to the police car
the china lid comes off the cistern
the glass dips into the last clean water

beats.name: P06 the growl, the door bulges

do.reason: Phoenix's stomach growls, far too loud
a dozen zombies press on the door
the door bows inward
the frame splits
wind five floors up
the street, far below
the ladder bends under two
a tin drops into the sack
a tin drops into the sack
a tin drops into the sack
a tin drops into the sack
the ladder bent deep under the sack
a tin slips out of the sack
the tin hits the police car's roof
the police car's siren goes off
hundreds of zombies, all looking up
both rails snap in the middle
the sack falls into the street
the flat door bursts in
the zombies pour into the flat
the first zombies hit the ladder's end
the Gunslinger's stomach

visible.why: P01: the door fight: hands in the gap, the arm on the Samurai's sash, Spud and the sofa, three faces over its back
the siren outside: the hands let go, the sofa shuts the door
P02: from the balcony: the whole street flows to the flashing police car
P03: the tap is dry; the last water is in the toilet cistern, three wait in the doorway with empty glasses
P04: the queue for the bucket behind the blanket on the balcony; nobody meets anybody's eyes
P05: one tin for five by candlelight, one spoon; the Wizard slumped; the barricade behind them
P06: Phoenix's stomach growls; everyone stares at him
the pane fills with silhouettes and the door bulges; four backs against the wardrobe: staying is over
P07: a ladder from the balcony to the shop roof, hundreds of zombies under it, none looking up
P08: the Gunslinger stuffs a sack far too heavy; Spud, with one tin, holds up a flat hand: enough
P09: he crawls back with the huge sack on his back; one tin slips out and falls
P10: the tin hits the police car, the siren; hundreds of faces turn straight up
P11: the ladder hangs in a V; Spud holds the Gunslinger by the hand, the sack in his other hand, until he lets it go
the flat door bursts: no way back
all five scramble over the cracked ladder; the zombies reach the balcony behind them
P12: all five alive on the roof at dawn with one tin; the old house's balconies full of zombies across the street; a stomach growls
